issue.title: BUG: ZeroDivisionError in scipy.sparse.linalg.lsqr
issue.body:
This problem was found as an unstable test in scikit-learn: scikit-learn/scikit-learn#2986.

This PR includes a non regression test and a potential fix (adding eps's in the denominators of fractions computed for convergence checks). I don't understand the overall algorithm but I think that those eps should be pretty harmless as they only impact quantities computed for breaking out of the loop, not the solution itself.

body: This has been fixed in scipy master (part of the future 0.15.0 release). I will do a backport for sklearn.

issue.title: [MRG] Fix ZeroDivisionError in LinearRegression on sparse data
issue.body:
This is a fix for #2986 by backporting the fix for scipy/scipy#4142. To do so I embedded a copy of the `scipy/sparse/linalg/isolve/lsqr.py` file from scipy as `_scipy_sparse_lsqr_backport.py` in `sklearn/utils`.

I extended the test in scikit-learn to trigger the issue consistently by using a range of random seeds.
